_note: Declared, deterministic curation only. Objective axes (cost, context, caps, throughput) merge live and are never here. THREE declared blocks: (1) `lineage` = (provider, generation, tier, tier_rank) — structural, stable, placed once per model; powers deterministic 'provider best' resolution and same-tier version ordering. tier_rank is 1=flagship WITHIN a provider (not cross-provider). (2) `cards` = the deterministic model card: a short `summary` + published `benchmarks` (sourced + dated). The card is NEVER mutated by feedback. (3) MEASURED quality (the feedback loop, see model_feedback) is served ORTHOGONALLY as `measured`, alongside — never merged into — the card. A model absent here is still fully routable on the objective axes.

claude-opus-5.summary: Anthropic Opus-tier flagship (supersedes Opus 4.8 at the same $5/$25 price); approaches Fable 5. Leads on repo-level coding (SWE-bench Verified ~96) and reasoning (GPQA Diamond 94.1); wins Frontier-Bench v0.1. 1M context, 128k output.

claude-fable-5.summary: Anthropic's top-tier flagship (above Opus); strongest coding and agentic tool use, 1M context.

claude-opus-4-8.summary: Anthropic Opus 4.8 — frontier reasoning and coding, 1M context, 128k output.

claude-opus-4-7.summary: Anthropic Opus 4.7 — prior Opus flagship, 1M context.

claude-sonnet-5.summary: Anthropic Sonnet 5 — balanced mid tier for everyday coding and agents, 1M context by default.

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.summary: Anthropic's fast, low-cost tier — extraction, classification and quick edits.

gpt-6-astra.summary: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra — frontier generation (2026-09-03). OpenAI launch-post table: Terminal-Bench 4.0 57.9 (Fable 5.1 55.8, Opus 5 52.6, Sol 37.3), DeepSWE v1.1 74.1 (Opus 5 73.7, Sol 72.7), GPQA Diamond 96.0, FrontierMath Tier 4 (v2) 97.6, MRCR v2 8-needle 512K-1M 96.3. 1.05M context, 128K output; reasoning effort low/medium/high/xhigh/max (no 'none'); rejects temperature. $10/$50, cache read $1.00, cache write $12.50 (1.25x). (No SWE-bench Verified figure published.)

gpt-5.6-sol.summary: OpenAI GPT-5.6 flagship (Sol) — SOTA on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (88.8; 91.9 Ultra) and DeepSWE for terminal/tool-heavy agent coding; very fast (~750 tok/s), token-efficient. 1.05M context. Frontier alternate: preferred over the Opus 5 primary for terminal long-horizon / max-throughput coding-agent work. (No public SWE-bench Verified / GPQA figure.)

gpt-5.6-terra.summary: OpenAI GPT-5.6 mid tier (Terra) — GPT-5.5-class quality at roughly half the cost.

gpt-5.6-luna.summary: OpenAI GPT-5.6 fast/cheap tier (Luna) — high-volume, cost-sensitive work.

gpt-5.5.summary: OpenAI GPT-5.5 — the widely-benchmarked full model; strong coding, 1M context.

gpt-5.5-pro.summary: OpenAI GPT-5.5 Pro — extra test-time compute for the hardest problems.

gemini-3.1-pro-preview.summary: Google Gemini 3.1 Pro — flagship reasoning with very long context (1M+) and multimodal input.

gemini-3.6-flash.summary: Google Gemini 3.6 Flash — newest Flash generation; 1M context, strong multimodal, higher-tier Flash pricing.

gemini-3.5-flash.summary: Google Gemini 3.5 Flash — fast and cheap, 1M context, strong multimodal and extraction.

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.summary: Google Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite — cheapest current Gemini tier; high-throughput extraction/classification, 1M context.

max.good_for: hardest reasoning, architecture, deep repo-level engineering - quality-first

frontier.good_for: hard bounded coding + reasoning subtasks - frontier quality (leads most coding/reasoning benchmarks) at lower cost; gpt-5.6-sol alternate for terminal long-horizon / max throughput

mid.good_for: most implementation, moderate reasoning, everyday agent work

cheap.good_for: mechanical edits, extraction, search, summaries, classification - near-mid quality at a fraction of mid cost
